text:
Ava M.: T-minus 3 days until the Velocity newsblast. Quick sync — segmentation, send windows, webinar tie-in?
Sam G.: Segments I propose: trial-active (last 14d activity), trial-expired (no activity >14d), early-adopters (signed up via beta list). Also a small VIP list for customers we want to route to sales.
Priya R.: Working on three subject lines and a 2-sentence benchmark blurb (framework: latency -> cost -> impact). Roughs: "Cut inference cost by 3x without latency loss", "Ship faster, save on infra: a Redwood story", and "Benchmark: predictable latency at scale". Preheaders ready after subject AB.
Diego K.: Send windows: NA primary at 10am PT, EU at 10am GMT+1, APAC stagger at 11am SGT. Plan to stagger by 2 hours for deliverability. I'll run the staging send using the ad-hoc tool:
```
./send_tool --env staging --campaign velocity-newsblast --window "2024-04-12T17:00:00Z" --cohort trial-active
```
Nora L.: Webinar tie-in: landing page with RSVP and two CTAs — "Attend live" (adds to calendar + reminder email) and "Watch recording" (drops into nurture). We should gate the recording download behind an email capture so we can route hot leads to SDRs.
Sam G.: For inbound routing: if RSVP + opens + clicked CTA -> mark as MQL and route to sales queue. Add tag: "velocity-webinar-rsvp". VIPs bypass nurture and go straight to AE touch.
Priya R.: Copy note: benchmark paragraph should call out a specific result: "In our internal suite, we observed 50–70 ms median latency at 8k token windows while reducing GPU token cost by ~60% relative to baseline runs." Keep it punchy, not academic.
Ava M.: Good. A/B test plan: subject A = performance claim, subject B = benefit claim (time to market). Preheader variations too. Send A to 10% control within each segment, measure open -> click -> webinar RSVP.
Diego K.: Tracking: canonical UTM params: utm_source=newsletter, utm_medium=email, utm_campaign=velocity_q2_launch, utm_content={subject_variant}. I'll attach tracking matrix in the doc. Also adding suppression for customers who had >3 emails in last 7 days.
Nora L.: On the landing page: include scheduling widget for 15-min demos for VIPs only. I'll build the widget region and pass the iframe to dev.
Priya R.: CTA copy variants: "See the benchmark" vs "Save on inference costs" vs "Watch the short demo". We'll map each to a different post-click experience.
Sam G.: Quick checkbox for deliverability: seed list (internal + gmail/owa/icloud samples), check SPF/DKIM, and a domain warmup note for the new subdomain. Diego can confirm deliverability checks passed before prod send.
Diego K.: Will run seed tests tonight and post results. Also scheduling the prod send job:
```
./send_tool --env prod --campaign velocity-newsblast --cohorts trial-active,trial-expired,early-adopters,vip --dryrun false --stagger-hours 0,2,4
```
Ava M.: Who owns the post-send benchmark narrative (we want a short blog + TL;DR for the newsletter)? Priya?
Priya R.: I'll draft the short blog and 3-line TL;DR for the email. ETA: end of day tomorrow.
Sam G.: Measurement: week 0 open rate, CTR, webinar RSVPs, MQL conversions, demo bookings. Diego — export post-send event stream to GA + internal dashboard.
Diego K.: On it. I'll also add a tracing tag so we can correlate token-level cost spikes back to specific sends.
LaunchBot: Reminder: campaign velocity-newsblast scheduled in 72 hours. Run preflight checklist 24 hours before send.
Ava M.: OK owners: Segmentation & routing = Sam, Send windows + deliverability = Diego, Webinar landing + demo widget = Nora, Copy + blog = Priya. I'll own launch ops. Everyone confirm? :rocket:
Sam G.: Confirmed.
Priya R.: Confirmed.
Diego K.: Confirmed.
Nora L.: Confirmed, will share iframe link by EOD.
Ava M.: Great — next check-in tomorrow 11am PT. If anyone hits blockers before then, ping #marketing-ops or DM. :thumbsup:
